title: ConnectWise investigating potential Cloud Backup Breach
content_md:
ConnectWise posted to their status page that they're investigating unauthorized access events in the Cloud Backup platform (which used to be SkyKick). So far they have NOT confirmed that anyone successfully got in, but third-party intelligence sources are saying that not only did someone get in, but also that the threat actor pivoted to the live O365 environments of customers of MSP's using ConnectWise Cloud Backup. For reference, Cloud Backup is used by MSP's to back up all of O365, including EntraID. So if someone did break in and access data files... this is gonna be bad. https://status.connectwise.com/ submitted by /u/MikeTalonNYC [link] [comments]

via reddit r/cybersecurity: ConnectWise investigating potential Cloud Backup Breach
